bio: Michael Marini is a Toronto mortgage broker with The Mortgage Group (TMG), claiming nearly 20 years in residential mortgages across Toronto, the GTA and Ontario. Services include purchases, transfers, renewals, refinances, equity takeouts, debt consolidation, reverse mortgages, and programs for self-employed borrowers, doctors and veterinarians. The site claims over 10,000 funded mortgages and 24-hour pre-approvals.
tagline: Find the Perfect Mortgage Solution with Me
